route.click_path: Playwright browser -> https://jenkinsmedicalcenter.com/pricing-transparency/ (HTTP 200). Page text describes 'The standard charges machine-readable file ... in compliance with 45 CFR 180.20' and presents two buttons: 'Hospital Shopables' and 'Standard Charges'. Both are <button> elements with no href and no onclick; clicking each (Playwright .click()) produced no network request for any CSV/JSON/ZIP and no modal with file links. Page HTML contains no *.csv/*.json/*.zip URLs and no Google Drive/Dropbox links.

checks.note: GET returned HTTP 404. Not evidence of noncompliance by itself.

Both 'Hospital Shopables' and 'Standard Charges' buttons are inert in the headless browser (no file request fired). The only cross-host asset observed is jenkinsmedicalcenter.tempurl.host (a staging-temp URL used for hero images), not a pricing file.
